description: Browse thousands of accommodations across Italy directly from Claude. Search by destination, dates, and guests to get real-time availability and pricing from Bed-and-Breakfast.it — Italy's leading commission-free platform for B&Bs, apartments, and holiday rentals. Book directly with hosts at the best price.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bed-and-Breakfast.it to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bed-and-Breakfast.it to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tools.bed-and-breakfast.it/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bed-and-Breakfast.it MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bed-and-Breakfast.it provides these MCP tools: search_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bed-and-Breakfast.it?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bed-and-Breakfast.it in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Bed-and-Breakfast.it does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Bed-and-Breakfast.it is developed by Studio Scivoletto srl. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
